attachments.origin_landmark: fascia over the lower nasal bone and upper lateral cartilage (bilateral; a single bone is named because the schema takes one origin)
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin of the glabella between the eyebrows

actions: draws the medial eyebrows downward, producing transverse wrinkles over the bridge of the nose

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: With corrugator supercilii it forms the glabellar complex -- the standard target for botulinum toxin treatment of frown lines, and the muscle group whose chemodenervation has been studied for depression.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse, over the nasal root/glabella, and also over the area between the medial canthus and nasal dorsum where procerus borders nasalis (the 'bunny line' region).
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Procerus does not meet nasalis, orbicularis oculi, or levator labii superioris alaeque nasi edge-to-edge at this junction: a consistent non-muscular gap (the 'bunny triangle') separates them, sized and shaped according to the width of the procerus and nasalis muscles.
structures_at_risk: corrugator supercilii and orbicularis oculi, immediately adjacent at the glabella/medial brow
nasalis, at the inferolateral border where bunny-line wrinkles form
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: A narrative review synthesizing multiple micro-innervation mapping studies of the upper face places neuromuscular-junction clustering in procerus 'inferiorly near the nasion', but gives no percentage-based reference line, so no motor_endplate_zones entry is recorded here pending a primary Sihler-type study of procerus itself. Border-relationship data for the adjacent 'bunny triangle' (procerus/nasalis/orbicularis oculi/levator labii superioris alaeque nasi junction) is based on ultrasonography in 13 volunteers and dissection of 39 cadavers.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Ahn H, Hu H, Kim SB, Lee JH, Choi YJ, Hu KS, Shah-Desai S, Abe S, Kim HJ, Clin Anat 38(6):686-691 (2024), doi:10.1002/ca.24249 (https://doi.org/10.1002/ca.24249) -- retrieved via PubMed; Magacho-Vieira FN, J Cosmet Dermatol 25(5):e70921 (2026), doi:10.1111/jocd.70921 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jocd.70921) -- narrative review, retrieved via PubMed
